title: Toddler Rodney at Pleasant Lake Picnic, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from July 4, 1950, capturing a young boy named Rodney crouching barefoot on the ground during a summer family picnic at Pleasant Lake. In the background, family members gather around a wooden picnic table set beneath shade trees, with food supplies and a Campbell's Tomato Soup box visible.
